evidence: The track to Middle Hill Hut begins at the north-west corner of the carpark.
Continue along the track from Middle Hill Hut until you reach a track junction.
A benched track leads from Kaweka Flats Bivvy to Makahu Saddle Hut, which is situated 5 minutes from Makahu Saddle car park (at the end of Kaweka Road).
You will need to organise transport from Makahu Saddle to Makahu Road.

doubts: The start is the carpark where the track to Middle Hill Hut begins; the text calls it only a carpark on Makahu Road, so the start is matched to F1 (the only track meeting Makahu Road in the packet) and this is not certain. The end is Makahu Saddle car park at the end of Kaweka Road, which has no feature entry, so its ref is null. The text says Makahu Saddle Hut is 5 minutes from that car park; the hut is passed on the way, so it is listed under huts and the car park is the end. The page gives DOC's time 5.5-7.5 hrs for the whole way; no distance is stated for the way (the three legs are 4.8 km, 5.58 km and 2.55 km, not summed in the text). Ford is given for the two named crossings (tributaries of Koaro Stream and the branch of the Makehu River) because the page says there are multiple unbridged stream and river crossings on this track; an unnamed stream crossing is left without a how. Camp Spur is the track not taken at the junction and is not matched to the Camp Spur ridge or track entries. Iron Whare is an optional side trip from the plateau. The Middle Hill Hut signpost partway along Makahu Road is not recorded as an access point because the text does not say it is a separate place to start.
